name: Pablo's Hotel
author: Wothanar
description:
I have made this game for the CWC game jam in just 3 days! im very tired after this huge work.
Pablo's Hotel is a business management game where you are the owner of your own hotel.
You have to reach profit goals on each levels for complete them and unblock the next levels. 
each level the game become harder and more customers arrive to your hotel due popularity should grow up on each level. 
Hope you people enjoy the game as much i enjoyed developing it. 
Have fun and thanks for playing!
Give a like!
Follow me on my OH... i dont have twitter. but come check my website www.pablomonfort.com Good luck.
